article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Javan Simmons scored 24 points as Ohio beat Buffalo 95-83 on Saturday. Simmons had 13 rebounds for the Bobcats (12-11, 6-5 Mid-American Conference). Aidan Hadaway scored 19 points and added nine rebounds. JJ Kelly had 17 points and shot 6 of 13 from the floor and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line. The Bulls (14-8, 4-6) were led by Daniel Freitag, who posted 25 points and four assists. Ryan Sabol added 22 points, six rebounds and five assists for Buffalo. Angelo Brizzi put up 15 points and two steals. Ohio took the lead for good with 10:59 left in the first half. The score was 46-31 at halftime, with Simmons racking up 16 points. Ohio was outscored by Buffalo in the second half by three points, with Kelly scoring a team-high 13 points in the final half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
